```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
roster_teams <- read_csv("~/Downloads/roster_teams.csv")
teams <- read_csv("~/Downloads/teams.csv")

teams_enhanced <- roster_teams |> 
  left_join(teams, join_by(ncaa_id)) |> 
  select(-url.y, -stats_name.y, -team.y) |> 
  rename(url = url.x, stats_name = stats_name.x, team = team.x)

write_csv(teams_enhanced, "teams.csv", na = "")

```
